_comment: OPTIONAL editorial layer, keyed by module/app name or package, merged OVER the autoloaded manifest. Every fact (title, version, icon, description, signer) is read from index.json automatically — this file only exists for things a manifest can't know. All keys optional; delete this file entirely and the catalog still renders. Supported keys per entry: featured (bool, floats to top), bucket (string, overrides the category grouping), blurb (string, longer copy than the manifest description), homepage (string, links the title), repo/source (string, → a 'Source' link), docs (string, → a 'Docs' link), website (string, → a 'Website' link), title (string, replaces the manifest display_name / F-Droid name), core (bool, true = infrastructure/dependency: hidden behind 'Show core modules' and not counted among apps; false = force-show). Basecamp module manifests carry NO repo URL, so add repo here to expose source; F-Droid apps already expose sourceCode/webSite and get Source/Website links automatically.
_comment_domains: WEBSITE LINKS: sites that exist use https://vpavlin.github.io/<repo>/ for now; KYM and WhisperBox have no site yet and point at https://github.com/vpavlin/<repo>. When the <app>.vpavlin.xyz domains are live, run `python3 scripts/switch-domains.py --write` to rewrite every one of them to https://<app>.vpavlin.xyz/ in one go (dry-run without --write).

ble_mesh.blurb: Bluetooth mesh bearer for Loam, wire-compatible with the Android Loam mesh. Experimental: Bluetooth sync currently works on Android only. Installed automatically with loam_core.

delivery_module.blurb: Logos Delivery (Waku) node that loam_core and the apps send and receive over. A backend dependency with no UI of its own; installed automatically.

keycard.blurb: Status Keycard smartcard module (PC/SC reader). Infrastructure for hardware identity; Keycard support in the apps is experimental.

keycard-ui.blurb: Keycard debug UI and test harness for the keycard module. A developer tool, not an app.

kith.title: Kith Core
kith.blurb: Kith's engine: the contact event log and sync over loam_core. Installed automatically with Kith.

kith_ui.blurb: Your people: a local-first, peer-to-peer address book. Rich contacts (phones, emails, messaging handles, notes) that can carry a Loam identity, synced across your devices with no server; vCard import/export. Install this; it pulls in the kith core and loam_core.

scala.title: Scala Core
scala.blurb: Scala's engine: the signed, end-to-end-encrypted calendar event log, roles (closed, open, collaborative) and sync over loam_core, with attachments on Logos Storage. Installed automatically with Scala.

scala_ui.blurb: Shared calendar, end-to-end encrypted and serverless. Several people edit the same calendar offline and converge with no write lost: recurring events, RSVP, custom fields, attachments, .ics import/export, multiple identities, Keycard support (experimental). Install this; it pulls in the scala core and loam_core.

storage_module.title: Logos Storage
storage_module.blurb: Logos Storage node: content-addressed, peer-to-peer file storage. Scala keeps sealed event attachments here. A backend dependency with no UI of its own; installed automatically.
